goals: Know who is reachable right now (SE Activity Status) to make intra-day assignment calls without guessing.
Keep the SE roster fit to work: correct availability state, approved leave, stocked vans.
Plan plant-visit intent ahead of the batch run via the SE Planner grid.
scopeNote: PRD groups SE list + Planner under one Flow (10: SE Management), matching admin routes /engineers, /engineers/manage, /engineers/planner, /leave-requests as one bounded context. Component-Blocked Queue (Flow 5, Ticket-centric, ZM read-only) is a SEPARATE module even though it shares the Common-Kit domain rule with this module's Van Stock completeness view (SE-centric) — do not merge them. Mobile SE availability/leave screens are in-scope per CLAUDE.md surfacing rule (one vertical slice) even though the picked persona is the ZM, not Ravi.

capabilities.name: Real-time SE Activity Status board (AVAILABLE/ON_SITE/BUSY/SHIFT_ENDING/OFFLINE, derived not stored)
capabilities.why: without it ZM cannot tell who is reachable for intra-day insertions and dispatches blind

capabilities.name: Set/override SE Availability (ON_LEAVE/OFF_SHIFT/WEEKLY_OFF/SOFT_UNAVAILABLE + time window)
capabilities.why: unavailable SEs keep getting scored by the Recommender, producing failed or wasted visits

capabilities.name: Approve/deny SE-submitted Leave Requests
capabilities.why: without an approval queue ON_LEAVE/WEEKLY_OFF never lands in SE_AVAILABILITY, so absences silently don't exclude the SE from candidate scoring

capabilities.name: SE Planner: multi-day plant-visit grid, drag-to-assign plant intent
capabilities.why: no plant-intent bias signal reaches the batch run, so ZM's territory plan and Recommender output stay incoherent

capabilities.name: Van Stock / Common Kit completeness view per SE
capabilities.why: SEs get silently grounded by the Hard Filter with no visibility to restock before it costs a day's assignments

capabilities.name: Coverage-type & Territory visibility (DEDICATED/MULTI_PLANT/FLOATING) on the roster
capabilities.why: without visible coverage type ZM can't judge fallback precedence or spot Territory/Plant coverage gaps behind failed assignments

capabilities.name: Availability audit trail (set_by, set_by_role, reason_code per SE_AVAILABILITY row)
capabilities.why: CONTEXT.md mandates an audited set_by_role on every write; without it disputes over who changed an SE's status are unresolvable

capabilities.name: Mobile: SE self-flags SOFT_UNAVAILABLE window + submits Leave Request
capabilities.why: this is the only upstream source for C2/C3 — without it the ZM's availability board and leave queue have nothing to act on
